ulus-of-hulegu has one resolve warning: counterpart nizari-ismaili-state has no polity or dossier yet.

yuan-dynasty and ming-dynasty need mirrored events for the Tarim, Almaliq, Beshbalik, Ariq Böke and Hami relations recorded here; kara-del should be a vassal/protectorate counterpart of ming-dynasty from 1404.

uzbek-khanate-of-abul-khayr and khanate-of-sibir both have Abu'l-Khayr as khan of Sibir 1428-1468; the colour agent should keep the steppe and Syr Darya in the Uzbek colour and West Siberia in the Sibir colour.
ariq-boke is a rebel claimant (type rebel) paired with the mongol-empire dossier's 'Ariq Böke' counterpart string; the colour agent should link the two.

Several pages disagree on dates (see _notes): Ögedeid end 1306 vs 1307; Baraq-Kaidu peace 1267 vs 1269; Hülegü's Caucasus defeat 1262 vs 1263; Berke's death 1265 vs 1266; Sufi dynasty end 1379 vs 1388; each dossier records the page it followed and the alternative.

Group scope names the Timurid partitions after 1405, the White Horde before 1363 and the Moghul Khanate before 1463; none were written because the batch is capped at ten states. The Ilkhanate's successor emirates belong to me-09.
Cliopatria's Georgia shapes have a gap 1241-1332; the 1240 shape was used as the reference in ulus-of-hulegu.
